summary.text: SpaceX's post-IPO price action dominates retail conversation, with SPCX trading sharply above its offering price and market cap comparisons to Microsoft fueling speculative fervor — though a vocal cohort questions whether the valuation is structurally supportable.

SPY call traders were rewarded handsomely after the Iran deal served as a weekend catalyst, reinforcing high-risk short-duration options behavior and emboldening a new wave of 0DTE and near-term high-conviction positioning heading into the week.

Beneath the euphoria, a minority of posts flag macro fragility — Bank of Japan tightening, AI IPO pipeline risks, and dot-com parallels — but these cautionary voices remain overwhelmed by the dominant risk-on mood currently gripping retail participants.
